A missing binary skips the test. A stale one raises AssertionError.

A cty call argument can only say
unknown, null or marked about a
function's answer, useless for the cty-package surfaces. So
values cross as JSON sentinels: $marks with $value, $unknown
round-trips the dialect so it is proven rather than assumed,
and a map key that would collide with a sentinel is an
rather than an approximation — an oracle that quietly renders
a value as something else still passes the comparison.
The checked-in fixture trees were deleted on purpose: ten of the
seventeen had been written with a trailing newline, and by then nothing read either tree.

And this runs in CI on a pinned Go toolchain
— a job checks out the harness repo beside

Go 1.27 and v17 at or above it, and four GB9c cases are strict xfails against the v15 answer.
